general_ui_ux_guidelines: Premium, Awwwards-level marketing site. Avoid generic, symmetrical 'PPT/AI slop' layouts. Rely on asymmetry, editorial layout patterns, high-contrast typography, layered textures (grain/noise + liquid glass), and refined motion. The design must feel crafted, elite, and deeply human (emphasizing the 'physician-in-the-loop'), not just another AI startup.

gradients.mesh_background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(11, 107, 101, 0.15) 0%, transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%, rgba(220, 203, 161, 0.05) 0%, transparent 40%)

editorial_patterns.hero_h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-serif tracking-tighter leading-[0.95]
editorial_patterns.section_h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-none
editorial_patterns.mixed_weights: Use Regular alongside Italic/Bold in the same heading to create editorial tension.
editorial_patterns.marginalia_labels: text-[10px] md:text-xs font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-label/80

textures_and_depth.noise_grain: A subtle global SVG filter or background image pattern (opacity 3-5%) layered over the background to break digital flatness.
textures_and_depth.hairline_rules: border-t border-white/[0.08] (use these aggressively for section dividers instead of just padding to create a 'magazine' feel).

layouts_and_grids.asymmetry: Avoid 6-col / 6-col splits. Use 4-col (Marginalia/Labels) + 8-col (Content/Images) on a 12-col grid.
layouts_and_grids.overlapping_elements: Images and floating glass cards should break out of their containers using negative margins (-mt-10) or absolute positioning.
layouts_and_grids.bento_editorial: When using grids for features, make one item col-span-2 row-span-2, and others smaller. Never symmetrical.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis is mandatory for momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.parallax_glass: Hero and feature sections should have floating glass panels that react slightly to mouse movement (rotateX/rotateY mapped to cursor) using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.reveal_animations: Use custom easing. transition: { duration: 1.2, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }. Elements should drift up (y: 40) and fade in smoothly.
motion_and_interactions.magnetic_buttons: CTAs should have subtle magnetic pull on hover (framer-motion or custom JS).

components.hero: Full viewport height. Abstract dark fluid mesh background. Massive Fraunces typography mixed with italic words. Floating liquid glass panels showing abstract data charts (Recharts) with deep teal glowing lines.
components.data_charts: Use Recharts with dark themes. Hide generic grids, use dashed faint lines (stroke='#ffffff' opacity=0.05). Line color: #14B8A6, with a gradient area underneath.
components.cards: Layered. Bottom layer is solid dark navy. Top layer is liquid glass shifted right by 10px and up by 10px. Don't use standard Shadcn cards without heavily stripping default borders and adding the liquid glass recipe.
components.navigation: Crystal Glass style. backdrop-blur-xl bg-deep_navy/50 border-b border-white/[0.05].

hero_abstract.description: Dark blue and black fluid art for hero background meshes and parallax elements.

team_physician.description: Modern physician portrait on dark background for Team or About section.

clinical_lab.description: Scientist looking through a microscope in a laboratory, used for Clinical Validation or Evidence sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 9 pages: Home, About, Vision & Mission, Product, Clinical Validation, Evidence, Team, Contact, Legal.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Avoid the generic 'AI startup' look. Emphasize the warm counter-accent (#DCCBA1) in labels and numbers to bring a 'human/editorial' feel.
Use Framer Motion extensively for reveal animations, parallax scrolling, and mouse-reactive 3D glass cards.
Apply the noise grain texture globally.
Use Recharts in the Product/Evidence sections to show data, styling it with custom teal gradients and minimal axes.
For the legal page, use an editorial index layout: a sticky sidebar for navigation and clean, beautifully spaced typography for the text.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text and warm accents maintain at least 4.5:1 against the dark navy base.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable heavy parallax or 3D rotations.
